### New Integrations


- [VRH ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/vrh-eld)


### Common Model Updates


- Expanded normalized[Vehicle](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/vehicle)` fuelType` coverage across many providers including: HOS247, TT ELD, TrackEnsure, Motive, GPS Insight, Webfleet, Route One ELD, TruckX, Motion ELD, Verizon Reveal and more.


### Integration Updates


- [Loop ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/loop-eld) now supports[HOS Logs](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/hos-log)
- [Loop ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/loop-eld) now supports additional[Vehicle Stat Logs](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/vehicle-stat-log) , including` odometer` and` engine_state`
- [Pedigree OneView](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/pedigree-oneview) now supports additional[Vehicle Stat Logs](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/vehicle-stat-log) , including` fuel_level` ,` engine_state` ,` coolant_percentage` ,` engine_coolant_temperature` ,` engine_oil_pressure` ,` engine_oil_temperature` , and` engine_rpm` , and now exposes optional` fuel` ,` engine_state` , and` engine_runtime` on[Latest Vehicle Locations](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/latest-vehicle-location)


### Documentation Updates


- Updated API and common model examples so enum fields like` visibility` ,` status` , and` fuelType` render in generated example payloads
- Updated[Motive configuration documentation](https://docs.withterminal.com/guides/motive-oauth-configuration) and[Samsara configuration documentation](https://docs.withterminal.com/guides/samsara-oauth-configuration) with current OAuth scope labels
